title: Cue: Teleprompter
shortDescription: Read scripts near the camera with scrolling, mirrors and recording tools.
fullDescription:
Prepare scripts and read at a comfortable pace. Adjust the text, reading line and scrolling speed, use mirrored text with a teleprompter rig, and record a take with the script near your camera.

Voice features depend on device support and installed on-device recognition resources.
